name: Le Méridien Mahabaleshwar Resort & Spa
why_special: Marriott's Le Méridien — Mahabaleshwar's only branded 5-star with 121 rooms across the ridge, indoor heated pool, full-service spa, the Latitude all-day diner. The hill-station 5-star default with the strongest reviews on Tripadvisor.

name: Brightland Resort & Spa
location: Khadi Ghat, near Mahabaleshwar bus stand
why_special: Brightland Group's flagship resort across 23 acres on the Khadi Ghat ridge — heated pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, Mahabaleshwar's longest-running mid-tier resort brand. The reliable 4-star bridge between MTDC and the Le Méridien.

name: Evershine Resort, Spa & Wellness
why_special: Evershine's 7-acre Old-Mahabaleshwar resort with heated pool and full-service ayurveda spa — strawberry-farm walks on-property (Mahabaleshwar's signature crop) and the closest mid-tier resort to the Panchganga temple.
